{{Quote|See, in the Clone Wars, they never used the Z-96. Only the Z-95.|Kazuda Xiono|audio=Z96-Bibo.flac|<ref name="Bibo" />}}
The '''Z-96''' was a class of [[starfighter]].<ref name="Details" /> In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date 34 ABY">{{ResistanceDate|1|12}}</ref> the [[pirate]]-turned-[[spy]] and [[scavenger]] [[Synara San]] was scavenging on the [[planet]] [[Castilon]]'s [[ocean]] when she pulled up wreckage from a [[Z-95 Headhunter]] and presented it to [[Team Fireball|Team ''Fireball'']], a group of [[Technician|mechanics]] based on the planet's [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]''. The mechanic [[Neeku Vozo]] believed the wreckage may have originated from a Z-96, but fellow team member [[Kazuda Xiono]] recognized it as a Z-95 due to the [[Starship|ship]] bearing the markings of [[Reaper Squadron]]. Xiono then further stated that the Z-96 was never used in the [[Clone Wars]],<ref name="Bibo" /> a [[The galaxy|galactic]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="USWNE">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Z-96 was first mentioned in "[[Bibo (episode)|Bibo]],"<ref name="Bibo" /> the twelfth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[January 13]], [[2019]].<ref name="Disney Press">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref> ''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'', a reference book released on [[October 4]], 2019,<ref name="USWNE Release">{{DK|url=us/book/9780241357668-ultimate-star-wars-new-edition|text=Ultimate Star Wars New Edition}}</ref> erroneously states that the starfighter wreckage is from a Z-96.<ref name="USWNE" /> This mistake was later repeated in the [[2024]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''.<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref>
